videos.title: Agents That Do Real Work | Hype Reel | DevCon 6
videos.description:
Anyone can build an agent. But to build a trustworthy agent at enterprise scale that is durable, long-running, optimized, contextually aware, and autonomous, the right infrastructure is required. 

At DevCon 6 we introduced the Agent Stack, the culmination of learnings gathered over years of agentic implementations. Orchestrator, Agent Engine, Agent SDK, Agent Builder, Agent Manager, AIP Evolve, SuperRepo, and so much more. All built on the Ontology, to power agents that actually work in production.

videos.title: On Repeat | 01
videos.description: Forged in the field. Proven in production.

videos.title: Ontology MCP | Ontology-Powered Tools for Internal Planning
videos.description: In this interview, Chad Wahlquist sits down with Mike Barone, Technical Program Manager at Palantir, to walk through how Palantir uses the Ontology MCP to run internal planning — connecting retrospectives, OKRs, and resourcing into a unified Ontology backend that agents can securely access.

videos.title: Transforming Rail with AI FDE | Palantir and Trinity Industries
videos.description: Trinity Industries manages one of the largest railcar lease fleets in North America — 140,000 rail cars and $8 billion in assets — with thousands of repair invoices requiring audit every month. In this session, Jean Savage, CEO and President of Trinity Industries, works with Palantir Software Engineer Ankit Shankar to build an intelligent invoice auditing workflow using Palantir AI FDE. From data ingestion to ontology design to a production-ready auditing application, the entire process unfolds in minutes. Learn more about Palantir AI FDE: https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/ai-fde/overview

videos.title: Ontology Governance | Building a Robust Ontology
videos.description:
In this interview, Chad Wahlquist sits down with Jonas Lang, a Forward Deployed Engineer at Palantir, to walk through the four core design principles for building a well-governed ontology, and the anti-patterns that can derail even the best-intentioned modeling efforts. 

Learn more:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YDAxITCNcko

https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/ontology/ontology-best-practices/

videos.title: ShipOS Supplier Spotlight | How a Navy Submarine Supplier Uses ShipOS to Improve Their Operations
videos.description:
Keel, a critical submarine industrial base supplier, demonstrates how ShipOS is transforming their operations.

ShipOS is the Navy's program to deploy Palantir Foundry across the submarine industrial base to accelerate production and improve operational efficiency, and get more ships in the water, faster. 

The time to modernize the submarine industrial base and rebuild American seapower is now.

videos.title: Chad & George | Defending the Enterprise with Security Forge
videos.description:
Defend the enterprise.

Security Forge, our new cyber security offering for source code vulnerability detection that moves at machine speed.

See how Chad and George used it to autonomously scan a codebase, compress 109 flags down to 10 actionable findings, and do it for $78 — so security teams know exactly what to fix and why.

Learn more: https://www.palantir.com/security-forge/

videos.title: Palantir's Ted Mabrey on AI, Healthcare, and the Future of Innovation | ARK Big Ideas Summit
videos.description:
Watch as John Couris, President & CEO of Tampa General Hospital, and Ted Mabrey, Head of Global Commercial at Palantir, speak about what it takes to transform one of America's most complex health systems - and why the Tampa Bay region is becoming a model for the rest of the country. Joined by Cathie Wood, Founder & CEO of ARK Invest, and Brian Cornell, Executive Chair of Target.


TGH and Palantir have worked together for over six years. Sepsis mortality at TGH has reduced from 10% to 5.3%. Nearly 900 patients have gone home who otherwise would not have.

videos.title: Empowering Frontline Support with AIP | Parts Town at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, Parts Town shows how Palantir AIP is transforming customer support and field service operations across specialty distribution. See how PartsIQ empowers support staff agents able to harness decades of institutional knowledge, leaving operators to focus on delivering the unique Parts Town experience. Then see that same Ontology extend into the field, powering intelligent dispatch, work order routing, and first-visit fix rate optimization across 1,800 technicians.

videos.title: Agentic Supply Chain for Data Center Delivery | Nscale at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, Nscale shared how they use AI to build for AI, with Palantir’s AIP powering the supply chain behind the world's next generation of AI infrastructure. From managing tens of millions of components across multiple construction projects to navigating rapid hardware transitions and long-lead procurement, see how Nscale uses agentic workflows backed by Ontology to deliver gigawatts of GPU compute on time at an increasing rate.
